newsitem.title: USA: Tridex Corp completes warrant exercise.
newsitem.headline: Tridex Corp completes warrant exercise.

text.p: Tridex Corp said on Monday that virtually all outstanding options and warrants to purchase Tridex common stock had been exercised and that all of the company's outstanding convertible debentures had been converted into common stock.
The company now has 5,372,010 common shares outstanding.

Tridex currently owns 5,400,000, or about 80.3 percent, of the common stock of TransAct Technologies Inc, will be distributed in a tax-free distribution on March 31, 1997 to Tridex stockholders of record on March 14, 1997 on the basis of approximately 1.005 shares of TransAct common stock for each share of Tridex common stock owned, the company said.
Tridex said that approximately 858,632 of the 862,742 outstanding options and warrants were exercised and that $2,460,000 principal amount of convertible debentures were converted.
Tridex currently has approximately $10 million in cash and cash equivalents and no funded long term debt, the company said.
